'''Clan Chorn''' was a clan of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in existence at the time of the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Eternal Empire's invasion]] of the galaxy. When [[Mandalore the Avenger]] rallied the clans in an attack on the [[Eternal Empire]]'s droid factory on [[Darvannis]], Clan Chorn was one of the clans able to aid her.<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Chorn was first introduced to [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]. The clan was featured in a choice given to the player during Chapter XIV, Mandalore's Revenge, where the player could choose between sacrificing or saving Clan Chorn when they are outflanked by [[Skytrooper]]s.<ref name="KOTFE" />
